Remark
[Codazzi identity for the Ricci tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0363 ↗ def:pet-ch9-codazzi-exterior-derivative The second fundamental form of an immersed hypersurface $M^n o \mathbb R^{n+1}$ satisfies the Codazzi--Mainardi equation $d^ abla \mathrm{II}=0$. For the Ricci tensor, \[ (d^ abla \operatorname {Ric})(X,Y,Z)=( abla ^*R)(Z,X,Y), \] and the Schouten--Weyl analogue is the corresponding identity from Petersen, exercise 3.4.26.
